title: Celebrate Conic Content Paint
description: When elements celebrate (data-celebrated=true), paint emphasized chrome (label text, icons, drag handles) with the same spinning three-brand conic gradient as the celebrate border ring—not solid foreground gray. Scope to leaf controls, not window/dock shell descendants.
summary: Celebrate icon/grip ink no longer leaks as a rectangular fill: removed invalid mix-blend-mode destination-in and oversized ::before conic layers. Icon stamps --icon-mask via memoized iconMaskImage(); CelebrateContent paints SVG icons with mask-image: var(--icon-mask) and visibility:hidden on inner svg; text/typst/shortcode/missing kinds use background-clip:text; themed icons included. Vitest CSS contract + icon markup tests updated; Playwright proof in ticket folder and ui-new-stories.spec.ts regression. Fixed vitest includeSource path to 📦index.tsx.
